positions.statement: In a February 2026 statement reported by the Tillamook County Pioneer on her filing, Armitage says Senate District 16 deserves good schools, along with affordable housing and health care and family-wage jobs.
positions.excerpt: Senate District 16 deserves the best: affordable housing and health care, family-wage jobs, good schools

verification.note: Quote is from Armitage in her filing statement (filed 2026-02-18, article 2026-02-19). Excerpt ends mid-sentence; the sentence then continues to a government that works for everyone, which the statement does not claim. Not misleading.

positions.statement: The Tillamook County Pioneer reported in February 2026 that, during her earlier Senate service, Armitage secured funding for infrastructure projects including a courthouse renovation.
positions.excerpt: Armitage secured funding for crucial infrastructure projects, including $2 million for a courthouse renovation

verification.note: Excerpt widened to include the subject and verb ("Armitage secured funding for crucial infrastructure projects"). Statement already attributes the claim to the Pioneer as a report about her earlier Senate service; article gives no date for the funding, and the statement adds none.

verification_summary.balance_notes: Race or-senate-16 swept 2026-10-19 with the same issue list and stop rules for all three candidates. Bangs: 11 T2 from a full campaign priorities page; Finkle: 1 T3 (no campaign site found); Armitage: 2 T3 (Pioneer filing story). Counts reflect available material, not unequal effort; pamphlet statements (T1) not yet collected for any of the three.
